MSG-P2-001 and MSG-GEN-005 are named by the FSD and the legacy exception flow but their texts are not in the source set, so the placeholder is carried until the Error and Message Standard names them.
edits.new:
The texts of the legacy story are copied unchanged; this contract adds no message and no wording. MSG-P2-001 and MSG-GEN-005 are named by the FSD and the legacy exception flow but their texts are not in the source set, so the placeholder is carried until the Error and Message Standard names them. The Error and Message Standard uses MSG-P2-001 and MSG-GEN-005 with other meanings than the rows above; until it confirms them, those rows keep their placeholder text.

The exception queue screen SCR-09 is not contracted here, and its empty, loading, error and no access states are Not specified in the source documents (DOR-RWB-P2-E2034-CON-10). The HTTP answers 401 (no session), 404 (unknown delivery) and 503 (dependency unavailable) carry no message ID in the source documents; those IDs are Not specified in the source documents (DOR-RWB-P2-E2034-CON-17).
